project: 2026 WNBA Efficiency Under Load | P0 frozen v1.0

cohort.retrospective_selection_note: season-end filters used only for descriptive model; for prediction use eligibility defined from prior-period data

features.minutes: Minutes as MM:SS converted to decimal minutes
features.game_ts_pct: 100*Points/(2*shot_opportunities), null when opportunities=0 (can exceed 100% on single-game sampling)
features.game_usage_pct: PBPStats Usage in percentage point units (e.g. 27.3), no recomputation
features.prior_usage_pct: prior up-to-10 player appearances, excluding current game; weighted by OffPoss, keeping prior rows with OffPoss>0 and non-null Usage
features.usage_delta_pp: game_usage_pct-prior_usage_pct; missing unless both terms valid
features.workload_band: lower if usage_delta_pp<=-5; elevated if >=5; typical if -5<delta<5; else unclassified
features.history_reliable: at least 5 prior valid usage games and sum of prior OffPoss >= 150
features.game_reliable: current minutes >=15, shot_opportunities>=5, used_plays>=5, usage present

model.primary: Within-player weighted least squares fixed effects, TS% on usage_delta_pp and game minutes; analogous TOV%, both outcomes expressed 0-100 percentage points
model.uncertainty: Player-cluster bootstrap of player-specific within-transformed sufficient-statistic contributions; 800 draws, percentile 95% CI; deterministic LCG seed=754321
model.interpretation: +5 percentage points of game usage relative to pregame baseline => adjusted association in TS% or TOV% percentage points (not causal)
model.descriptive_bands: Pooled points/(2*opportunities) and turnovers/used_plays; unadjusted observational summaries, NOT player-adjusted group effect
sensitivity: at least 8 prior valid usage games
exclude group games below 15 current minutes

guardrails: No mutation of existing Hidden Value / Role Fulfillment / Functional Depth / Scalability weights or outputs
TS% and TOV% share components with usage and may be mechanically dependent; workload can respond to in-game performance, so estimates are not causal
Season-end eligibility creates selection bias for future-facing validation
Shot-quality, playmaking and teammate-availability context are deferred P1/P2
Preserve raw zero-vs-null evidence and do not recode zero denominators as zero percentages
Do not interpret usage changes as exogenous workload assignments
